channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker

item.title: US-Iran talks in New York: What’s the latest?
item.description: Both sides remain interested in a diplomatic settlement but differ on how to achieve one.

item.title: CDC reports two measles deaths in US as cases hit 35-year high
item.description: Pennsylvania reports over 900 measles cases, leading a nationwide outbreak with the highest numbers in 35 years.

item.title: Photos: French students protest, public workers strike before budget cuts
item.description: About 40 people have been arrested and 10 injured as protesting students clash with police.

item.title: Are Houthis using new modified cruise missiles in Yemen’s war?
item.description: Experts say use of modified Iranian defence system could alter the balance in the fight for the Red Sea.

item.title: Iran downplays possible role in Houthis’ recent Yemen victories
item.description: Iran has long been accused of links with the Houthis in Yemen, but how far do these links go?

item.title: Iranians stock up on food and medicine as fears of new US fighting grow
item.description: Iran is struggling with shortages as sanctions and blockade strain food and medicine supply chains.

item.description: Iran is using Hormuz to seek US concessions, relief for the Houthis and greater control over Gulf shipping.

item.title: Israeli settlers attack West Bank village and block Palestinian family's return home
item.description: Two homes belonging to the al-Tubasi family were set on fire and Israeli security forces were also targeted by settlers.

item.title: Twelve women have been killed in one part of South Africa since July. Here's what we know so far
item.description: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa says the murders are a "stain on our national conscience".
